scope.feature: EDT-022 / versioned legacy media playback safety
implemented: Versioned legacy audio cannot publish with native controls hidden.
Versioned legacy video cannot publish with unmuted autoplay.
Video controls may be hidden only for explicitly muted autoplay background video.
Inspector warnings are publication-only so Save can preserve a recoverable draft; Publish remains a separate server-validated action.
Historical unversioned media documents are not silently reclassified.
